probe: the acceptance layer's own fail-controls: every assertion driven to each state it can reach (SPEC.md §5.2.8; ticket 0578's Test section)
not_a_test_suite: these are fixtures, not targets. A red here is the instrument working: a fixture built to fail an assertion must fail it, and this artifact is red when the fail-controls come back green.
